name: Shopan!
source:
Ryuichi and Kaori are childhood friends. They often have a battle for something. One day, Ryuichi tells her that if he wins the next battle, he'll get her "body".... Kaori loses, and they have sex at last. Since then, they have sex anywhere they like....

[From ErogeShop]
